notes: Snap election called by PM Sanae Takaichi. LDP won historic two-thirds supermajority (316/465 seats), roaring back after 2024 money scandal losses. Takaichi became Japan's first elected woman PM with sweeping mandate for conservative policy agenda.
Constitutional Rewrite — Voters approved beginning the process of drafting a new constitution to replace the 2017 coup-era charter. YES won with 21.62M votes vs 11.24M NO.

notes: Bhumjaithai Party emerged as surprise winner despite only leading caretaker government for 4 months. Constitutional referendum also held same day. Bhumjaithai formed coalition with Pheu Thai. Described as a shock result and complete upset.

BNP won majority. Awami League boycotted. Elections followed August 2024 student-led protests that ousted PM Sheikh Hasina. UPDATE Jul 24 2026: President Mohammed Shahabuddin (Hasina ally, in office since Apr 2023) resigned citing health (Autonomic Neuropathy). Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmad acting as president. New president must be elected within 90 days. Hasina (sentenced to death in absentia) has stated intent to return from India exile in December 2026. Sources: BBC, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP
July National Charter Reforms — Voters approved institutional governance reforms based on the July 2024 uprising demands (democratic safeguards, accountability measures).

notes: RSP won 182/275 seats. Nepali Congress 38, CPN-UML 25. First time a new party won majority. Shah became youngest PM in Nepal history.

Greens narrowly held power. Ozdemir (former federal agriculture minister) succeeded Kretschmann. CDU came within 0.6 points. AfD doubled its 2021 result to ~20%. SPD hit record low. Left Party entered parliament for first time. Sources: DW, OSW, GMF
